claim: A six-fight run reaches a real end screen.
sandbox: Enter /demo, use a correct safe prefix through the remaining fights, and observe the completed six-fight end screen.

claim: Restarting a run resets it to fight 1 with full health.
sandbox: Enter /demo, finish the sample, restart, and inspect the first fight and health display.

claim: Non-timed mode keeps a route visible and persists in the current browser.
sandbox: Enter /demo, enable non-timed mode, reload, wait past the normal hide time, and observe that the setting and route remain visible.

claim: Runs and settings stay on this device without analytics or account requests.
sandbox: Record every request through a demo interaction, require same-origin traffic, and verify demo actions leave a real-run storage value unchanged.

claim: A correct partial route is a safe combat move.
sandbox: Enter /demo, choose the visible route's first symbol, commit, and observe the Guard outcome with unchanged health.

claim: One click opens a populated demo with a persistent sample label and no changes to real game data.
sandbox: Set a real-run storage sentinel, use the sample action, reset and play the populated fight-3 sample, keep the demo label visible, and assert the sentinel is unchanged.

claim: Demo progress and settings are discarded when the player starts for real.
where: demo controls, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: Create demo run and settings state, choose Start for real, assert both demo keys are gone and real data is unchanged, then reopen a fresh sample.

claim: A run uses six routes that grow from 3 to 7 symbols.
where: How to play, README, design record
sandbox: Enter /demo, restart a full run, clear each fight with a safe prefix, and observe route lengths 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7.

claim: Recalling the whole route uses Strike.
sandbox: Enter /demo, select every visible route symbol in order, and observe the Strike outcome.
Enter /demo, submit a different first symbol, and observe health fall from 4 to 2.

claim: Three wrong reads end a full-health run.
sandbox: Enter /demo, restart at 6 health, submit three wrong routes, and observe the loss screen at 0 health with restart focused.

claim: Core play controls work with touch, mouse, Tab, Enter, and Space with visible focus.
sandbox: Use keyboard navigation and activation with a visible focus outline, use a pointer action, then complete a Guard move in an independent touch-enabled browser context.

claim: The game respects the browser's reduced-motion preference.
sandbox: Enter /demo with reduced motion enabled, produce a miss, and measure the rendered impact animation duration.

claim: Every route symbol has a visible name, shape, and spoken cue.
sandbox: Enter /demo and inspect each route step for its visible glyph and name plus an accessible spoken cue.

claim: The complete six-fight game with route variations, relics, and accessibility settings is US$4.99 one time; checkout and license validation remain unavailable.
where: complete game offer, terms, license status, README
sandbox: Enter /demo, exercise route variation, relic and settings UI, then open the offer route and verify its exact price, included content, and unavailable checkout and validation.
